properties.Notes: This individual was far more willing than his peers to stay close to the bank as our mekoros passed by. Perhaps a bluff to boost his status in the troop!

Seen from a distance the morning of our departure from Sambira baobab. Out of the frame is a group of impala nearby. Incredible to see.

properties.Notes: This hippo was very aggressive, It charged several of our team members several times, though always backing down at the edge of the pool. This was a tough one to pass with the mekoros.
This meter-long monitor lizard was perched casually atop the low-lying swamp vegetation as we passed just behind it.

These elephants walked past me just meters away as I packed up my tent. It is an interesting feeling to stand as an elephant stomps and bucks its massive head at you with outstretched ears to get some space for its youngling to pass by behind it. Respectfully, I stepped back very slowly and the elephants continued to this channel.
